messages:
zoe (Docs): flagging a docs vs runtime mismatch on /rerank endpoint. examples show `score` normalized 0.0-1.0 but API returns raw logits (can be negative). JS snippet sorts ascending.

andre (API): oof. link?

zoe (Docs): https://redwood.dev/api-ref#/rerank/post in the response example. shows scores like 0.87, 0.42. our prod traces show values like -2.3, 0.5, 1.2.

peter (SDK): that's why the SDK comparator we shipped failed unit tests for some edge cases. we assumed normalized scores.

maya (QA): we hit this in integration tests when validating top-k ordering against model outputs. flaky when negative logits appear.

andre (API): looks like the docs example was left over from a post-processing idea that never shipped. runtime always returned raw model scores (logits) and consumers do their own softmax/normalize if needed. my bad.

zoe (Docs): proposal: change the example to show raw logits (e.g., -2.34, 0.91, 1.77), update the JS/TS snippet to sort by descending numeric value (not assume 0-1), and add a short note: "scores are raw model logits; use softmax or a normalization helper if you need 0-1 probabilities."

peter (SDK): i'll update the SDK comparator to sort numerically descending and add a helper `normalizeScores(scores, method='softmax')`. i'll open a non-breaking PR and include updated quickstart snippets. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/260

andre (API): optional: we can add an example field in the OpenAPI that shows both raw and normalized variants, e.g., `score` and `score_probability` to prevent future confusion. but that changes the schema. maybe better to keep schema simple and show both in docs text.

zoe (Docs): agreed — docs will show the raw score in the canonical response example and a tiny side-by-side code example demonstrating softmax normalization. will also add a troubleshooting note: "If your code assumes 0-1, update to use helper or SDK >=0.14.1."

maya (QA): can we add a test in the examples harness to validate that the example shapes match SDK types? would have caught this earlier.

peter (SDK): good idea. i'll add an examples smoke test that parses the docs JSON examples and asserts types align with client types. PR will include that.

andre (API): i'll update the internal generator to avoid emitting normalized example values for rerank. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1133

docbot: docs PR opened by zoe: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/578 (updates rerank example, adds normalization snippet, changelog entry).

zoe (Docs): merged after quick review. verified snippet sorts correctly and the normalization demo computes probabilities in the storybook sample.

peter (SDK): merged SDK changes and published canary 0.14.1-canary.0 with normalize helper and comparator fix. updated quickstart.

docbot: docs deploy scheduled by zoe for 2026-04-02T09:00:00-07:00.

zoe (Docs): added a short FAQ blurb and pinged #support. will follow up if we see further mismatches. :white_check_mark:
